packages.label: נְשִׁיקִין
packages.reason: All three nodes share the essential nature of the holy kiss — the merging of two spirits through the mouth of Torah. The teaching equates: נשיקין = התדבקות רוחא ברוחא (union of spirit with spirit); 'שפתותיו שושנים' (Song of Songs 5:13) = the lips that kiss = נשיקין; 'שפתותיו שושנים' = התדבקות רוחא ברוחא. This is a perfect triangle: the kiss IS the union of spirits, and the Song of Songs verse IS the kiss. All three are faces of the same spiritual-union reality that occurs when a righteous learner studies the Torah of a Tanna.
merge_notes: Raw bechina component: triangle of 3 nodes with 2 edges each. No merges required.

packages.label: תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל־פֶּה
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of תורה שבעל פה — the Oral Torah as the Shekhinah, the mouth-dimension of holiness, the repository of halakhot that give life. Core connections: דוד = תורה שבעל פה (the Psalm 'Tehillah leDavid' speaks of the fallen/mixed Oral Torah); יין = תורה שבעל פה (wine = malkhut rav = the Oral Torah in its royal dimension); רחל = תורה שבעל פה (Rachel stands before her shearers = the Oral Torah from which all halakhot are sheared); יין = בינה לבא (the two faces of wine — Oral Torah and the heart's understanding); יין = שמחת הלב (wine = heart's joy = the same inner-dimension). The שמאלה node and its pair (the Tanna's involuntary slight fall) are also merged here: 'שמאלה — עושר וכבוד' is explicitly the LEFT face of Torah (Mishlei 3:16), the dimension through which material sustenance flows — it is a structural feature of תורה שבעל פה itself, not a separate or evil domain. The green-beginning cluster (אני חבצלת, אסתר ירקרקת) is also merged here: 'אני חבצלת' = the Shekhinah in its initial green state before ascent; 'אסתר ירקרקת' = the same green quality. The Shekhinah IS תורה שבעל פה, and its initial state of being fallen among the Lamdanim is the teaching's core drama.
nodes: נפל התנא בשעת אמירת תורתו לאיזה שגיאה דקה כחוט השערה
merge_notes: Raw bechina component {תורה שבעל פה, יין, בינה לבא, שמחת הלב, דוד, רחל}: 6 nodes, 5 edges (יין is the hub with degree 3 in raw component).

Merged isolated pair {אני חבצלת, אסתר ירקרקת}: 'אני חבצלת' = the Shekhinah in its initial green/fallen state (Song of Songs 2:1); 'ירקרקת' = green = the same quality. The source text explicitly identifies this green state as the Shekhinah (= תורה שבעל פה) before it ascends through חיבוק. Nature: the Shekhinah-Torah in its beginning/fallen state.

Merged isolated pair {נפל התנא..., שמאלה}: 'שמאלה' = the left hand of Torah = 'עושר וכבוד' (Mishlei 3:16). The Tanna's involuntary slip to שמאלה is how the Torah draws material sustenance for the world. This is a structural feature of תורה שבעל פה — its left/material-sustaining face. Shared nature: the left dimension of Oral Torah that provides for the world.

packages.label: חִבּוּק וִימִין
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of חיבוק — the loving embrace of the right hand. Core connections: ימין = חבוק (the right hand IS the embrace); אהבה שהצדיק מקבל את החרפה באהבה = חבוק (the tzaddik's loving acceptance of humiliation IS the embrace); אברהם = ימין (Abraham embodies the right side, the quality of chesed). The isolated pairs חניכיו/חסדים and וירק/קו הירק are merged here by shared nature: חניכיו = חסדים (the 318 trained men = Abraham's chesed-disciples, per Midrash Bereshit Rabbah 43 — חניכה = name = Abraham = chesed); וירק = קו הירק (the green line drawn from Binah that encircles the world = the external expression of the chesed/embrace-energy). In the source text, 'וירק' and 'חניכיו' appear in the same verse (Bereshit 14:14) about Abraham — together they are the mechanism of חיבוק: Abraham (right/chesed) pours the green line of chesed through his disciples. Shared nature across all eight nodes: right-side / chesed / loving-embrace.
nodes: אהבה, שהצדיק מקבל את החרפה באהבה
merge_notes: Raw bechina component {חבוק, ימין, אהבה שהצדיק..., אברהם}: 4 nodes. ימין and חבוק are the hub-pair (degree 2 each).

Merged isolated pair {חניכיו, חסדים}: 'חניכיו' = the 318 trained men of Abraham = חסדים (Bereshit Rabbah 43: 'leshon chanikato sheshman Avraham kishmo'). חניכיו and חסדים share the nature of Abraham's chesed — they are the concrete embodiment of ימין/חבוק. Nature: Abraham's chesed-emanation = the right-arm embrace in action.

Merged isolated pair {וירק, קו הירק}: 'וירק' (Bereshit 14:14) = קו הירק (the green line drawn from Binah that encircles the world). This green line is the same quality as 'אני חבצלת / אסתר ירקרקת' (green). In the source text this is explicitly the mechanism of חיבוק — the flow from Binah through the right arm that embraces. Nature: the green-chesed emanation that IS the embrace's energy. Note: although the green quality appears in Package 2 as well (חבצלת/ירקרקת), the node 'קו הירק' specifically refers to Abraham's action-moment ('וַיָּרֶק אֶת חֲנִיכָיו') and flows into this right/chesed cluster.

packages.label: שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים
packages.reason: All four nodes share the essential nature of the two-Tzaddikim structure between whom the Shekhinah dwells. The teaching quotes Zohar: 'tzaddikim terei mashma — tzaddikim yirshu aretz' = two tzaddikim. The bechina equations: 'יעלו שמים' (Psalms 107) = צדיק עליון (the upper/originating Tzaddik, the Tanna who innovated the Torah); 'ירדו תהומות' = צדיק תחתון (the lower/receiving Tzaddik, the one who currently studies). The isolated pair {'ירדו תהומות', צדיק תחתון} merged with {'צדיק עליון', 'יעלו שמים'} because they share the SAME NATURE — both pairs are faces of the identical two-tzaddikim structure. 'יעלו שמים' and 'ירדו תהומות' are the two poles of the same cosmic verse that maps onto the upper and lower tzaddikim. They are inseparable by definition — neither can exist without the other.
merge_notes: Two isolated 2-node components merged: {צדיק עליון, 'יעלו שמים'} + {'ירדו תהומות', צדיק תחתון}.

Justification: These two pairs are explicitly parallel faces of the same structure — the verse 'יעלו שמים ירדו תהומות' (Psalms 107:26) is decoded in the source text (section ד, lines 51-52) as the two tzaddikim between whom the Shekhinah sits. 'יעלו שמים' = the upper tzaddik (who lifts); 'ירדו תהומות' = the lower tzaddik (who descends to receive). Their shared nature is: the two-pole structure of tzaddik-Shekhinah-tzaddik = the vessel for the Shekhinah's dwelling. They could not meaningfully be placed in any other package — their essential identity IS this duality, and both pairs must be in the same package.
